epic.summary: Three-tier dev-time agent memory for makato-suite
epic.objective: Make agent memory a platform-wide capability across loop, build, and change lanes, persisted beyond spec-folder archival.

_decompositionNotes.threeAmigos: PO, Dev Lead, QA reviewed 2026-07-19. Strong convergence.
resolvedAmbiguities: PER-ISSUE LESSONS STORE (load-bearing, flagged by Dev+PO+QA): loop lane uses workflow-state.json:lessons_learned[] (exists today, documentation-agent already reads it). Change lane has no workflow-state -> writes a new specs/<issue>/change-lessons.jsonl. Build lane (S4) writes the same change-lessons.jsonl-style per-issue artifact. documentation-agent (S2) promotes from BOTH sources.

RECALL SIGNATURE backward-compat (all three): bundles[] and labels[] are OPTIONAL (empty = no-filter). Existing 2-arg call `recall-lessons <REPO> [N]` must keep working. po-agent Step 2c call-site update is IN SCOPE for S1.

S4/S5 blockedBy corrected per Dev Lead: change-lane (seq 5) is blockedBy S1 ONLY (recall reads the store from S1; S2 promote is a soft/informational coupling, not a gate). lesson-prune (seq 6) blockedBy S1,S2 (operates on the promoted committed store).

SEMANTIC TIER writer IS in v1 (operator decision): write lanes (S4 change, S5 build-write) emit both procedural lessons AND semantic agent-facts, so semantic.jsonl is genuinely populated, not empty scaffolding.

S2 write allow-list (Dev, Major): documentation-agent.md Rules must add .makato/memory/ to allowed write paths; promote logic extracted into a standalone shell helper so it is CI-smoke-testable without the LLM agent.

stories.summary: Persistent memory store and shared recall

description.background: Memory today is pinned to the wrong layer (po-agent only) and a transient location (per-issue spec folders that archive-spec moves below the recall glob). This foundation story creates a persistent committed store and extends recall to read it, so every lane can converge on one memory source.
description.scope: Create .makato/memory/ with two committed JSONL files (semantic.jsonl, procedural.jsonl per R1). Add `.makato` to scripts/check-root-structure.sh ALLOWED (one array entry; hidden-dir branch reuses the same array). Update .gitignore to commit exactly semantic.jsonl and procedural.jsonl while keeping episodic *.jsonl ignored (negation pattern). Extend shared/workflow-state.sh `recall-lessons` to accept OPTIONAL bundles[] and labels[] (empty = no-filter, preserving the existing `<REPO> [N]` 2-arg call); read .makato/memory/*.jsonl (resolved at REPO_ROOT main checkout, not the worktree) alongside live workflow-state-*.json; filter `repo AND (bundle in my_bundles OR label in my_labels)`; order `scope, occurrences DESC, recency`; skip malformed JSONL lines without aborting. Update po-agent Step 2c call-site. Update SKILL.md / README / CHANGELOG for the new signature.

description.background: Archival kills recall today: live workflow-state JSON drops below the recall glob when archive-spec moves the folder. Promotion at merge lifts durable, generalizable memory into the committed store so it survives archival. Confirmed opt-in (R2): runs only where post-merge.yml is installed — for makato itself it already is.
description.scope: Add a promote step to documentation-agent (CI, per-merge). Extract the dedup+write+stamp logic into a standalone shell helper (analogous to resolve-append-only-conflict.sh) so it is smoke-testable in CI without the LLM agent. The helper reads per-issue sources — workflow-state-*.json:lessons_learned[] (loop lane) AND specs/<issue>/change-lessons.jsonl (change/build lanes, produced by S4/S5) — does exact hash(normalized_text)+tags dedup (bump occurrences++ on match), promotes only records flagged scope:generalizable, and stamps repo_sha + date. Extend documentation-agent.md Rules write allow-list to include .makato/memory/. Pin the normalization function and the repo_sha source (document both in the helper).

description.background: Closes gap #1: build-implement-tdd consumes PRIOR_LESSONS but only the po-agent fills it, so a manual /build-start leaves the coder with no historical memory. PRIOR_LESSONS infrastructure already exists in coder.md and build-implement-tdd — the only gap is that build-start never calls recall.
description.scope: Add a guarded recall step to build-start/build-refine: fill PRIOR_LESSONS by calling recall-lessons when it is absent from the input bundle (Q5). If PRIOR_LESSONS is already present (po-agent path), the step is a no-op. At build-start there may be no changed files yet, so recall falls back to labels-only (empty bundles). Empty store must not block the build.

description.background: The spec names po/build/change as all three writers, but recall alone (S3) makes the build lane read-only — builds consume memory but never contribute. This story makes the build lane symmetric: it writes raw per-issue lessons AND semantic agent-facts at session end for documentation-agent (S2) to later promote.
description.scope: At a build session terminal step (build-verify or build-push-to-git), emit raw per-issue records to specs/<issue>/change-lessons.jsonl: procedural lessons (bugfix/gotcha patterns) and semantic agent-facts (durable technical facts), each stamped tier + text + tags + scope (generalizable|local). This is the same per-issue artifact shape S5's change lane writes and S2's promote helper reads. No direct writes to .makato/memory/ (promotion is S2's job).

description.background: Grow-append memory needs occasional human-gated curation. This is an operator tool, not a per-issue build step. Ported from the positronic vault prune skill, adapted to JSONL and repo_sha/date-aware STALE detection. Prune is destructive, so diff-before-write + explicit approval is load-bearing.
description.scope: New makato-orchestrate:lesson-prune skill, JSONL-native, human-gated. Classify each record KEEP / DUPLICATE / GRADUATED (present in AGENTS.md) / STALE (repo_sha unreachable from HEAD AND old date) / CONSOLIDATE. Render a classification table (diff-before-write) and mutate only on explicit operator approval. Non-interactive all-KEEP path is a no-mutation exit-0. STALE uses a real git repo fixture (worktree-smoke-tests sandbox pattern). Document the rare-but-valid false-positive class requiring human judgment. Confirm the positronic source scope before locking the estimate.
